# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VWAP_RECLAIM_WITH_VOLUME_SPIKE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After the midday lull (11:30-13:00 EST), SPY often exhibits a short-term mean-reversion snapback to the intraday VWAP on elevated volume, reflecting liquidity-driven price correction. This edge exists because institutional algos frequently deploy VWAP-based execution strategies during low-activity periods, creating predictable mean-reversion when volume spikes confirm genuine participation rather than noise.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Between 11:30-13:00 EST, if a 5-minute bar closes above VWAP after opening below it (bullish VWAP reclaim) AND that bar's volume ≥ 1.8× the average 5-minute volume of the prior 60 minutes, enter long at the bar's close.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the most recent swing low (prior lower high). Take profit 1 at 1.5R (risk-reward). Runner trail: 10% below highest close since entry. Time exit at 15:50 ET.  
**Regime filters:** Only active when VIX < 25 AND price has remained within ±0.5% of VWAP for at least two consecutive 5-minute bars earlier in the session (9:30-11:30 EST), indicating absence of strong directional bias.
